facts.fact: ESA states that VITO built Earth-observation crop classifiers from nearly 800 FSRP field points collected in August-September 2023, trained Ministry of Food and Agriculture officials in March 2024, and adapted a Ghana CLIMTAG dashboard, with Ghana planning to operationalise it in the GhAAP platform.

systems.owner: VITO for World Bank FSRP, used by MoFA and GMet

GHA.note: Ghana Meteorological Agency is named only as a user of the dashboard; no satellite use in its forecasts is stated.
Stakeholder consultations concerned designing a climate tool, not a named digital law or policy.
